title: Story OS Visual Lock
description: Visual Profile Governance Phase 3.5. A Visual Lock records the selection fact and the confirmation fact for one Episode so a gate can verify that a profile was chosen on purpose, by someone, at a certain time. Existence of a file is not evidence; the locked selection and its adjudication are.

selection.description: Adjudicated outcome. A string is the selector status; an object is the free-form selection payload.

status.description: Equivalent top-level spelling of the selector status.

selection_evidence.description: The selection fact emitted by the Selector (Phase 3.2 contract). Copied, never recomputed.

confirmation_mode.description: human and system are canonical; direct_user and delegated_auto are accepted equivalents of human review.

lifecycle_state.description: Visual Profile Governance Phase 4.2 lifecycle. SELECTED and NEEDS_CONFIRMATION are drafts; LOCKED is adjudicated; FROZEN means production assets exist and the profile may no longer change.

confirmation.description: Phase 4.2 confirmation record. The top-level confirmation_mode / confirmed_by / confirmed_at fields stay the canonical Phase 3.5 spelling and are kept in sync with this block.
